what_this_is_not: NOT pytest. This runner does not discover, collect, fixture-inject, xfail or report the way pytest does. A case needing a fixture, a parametrisation or a construct outside supported_constructs is reported UNSUPPORTED and counted as NOT-RUN, never as passed, so the counts here are an UPPER BOUND on what pytest would execute. A SHIM_PASS does NOT withdraw the standing disclosure that the lane's pytest scope is unexecuted in the producer image and that the snapshot-audit READY verdict is conditional on that absence.
why_it_exists: An unexecuted test file is an unverified claim. This converts the lane's pytest-style tests into a measurement in an image where pytest is absent, without pretending the absence is fixed.
